notablePrerequisites: You control creatures that can produce at least {1}{G}{G}{G}.
description:
Activate creatures you control by tapping them, adding at least {1}{G}{G}{G}.
Activate Biogenic Ooze by paying {1}{G}{G}{G}, creating a 2/2 Ooze creature token.
The Ooze enters the battlefield, triggering Intruder Alarm, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.
If you can produce at least one additional mana in step 1, this combo produces infinite mana.
